subject: afi
title: AFI. -----SCI.DYM.
description: Second diagram on page 86 (CS-14). The crossing diagrams how affinity-insight structurally meets scientific-dynamics at the western-science-affinity-stance scale the prose names: 'the continuum of western scientific thought is directly based in the affinity stance of western culture - having to do with perception within an existential information focus.' AFI (affinity insight) crossed with SCI.DYM (scientific dynamics). AFI sits at upper-center with the subject-arrow; HI-P (high purpose) upper-left and (R)INT (the reality of intention) at left as the subject-side leftward chain, with DEC (decentralization) branching from INT. POST (postulation) branches from the main line to the right, with COS-P (cosmic-particulars) branching from POST and APL-DT (application dictates) from COS-P. ACC-FT (accelerated functionalism) branches down from the main line, with BIA (bi-aitional) branching from ACC-FT and EXP-DY (expansion dynamics) from BIA. SCI-DY (scientific dynamics) ends the main line at lower-left.
